label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.103…: Government has two parts, the design and its execution…
locator: I q.103 a.6 co.: the design of government, which is providence itself; and the execution of the design
interpretation: Government has two parts, the design (providence) and its execution; as to the design God governs all things immediately, as to execution through others. Kept as prose. It supports, without stating, the open bridge STMT-UNMOVED-DIRECTOR-HAS-THE-DESIGN (Codex P1 on #196: a.6 attributes the design to God and does not infer it from being an unmoved director). Basis: the English Dominican translation (web snapshot); a candidate for upgrade once a pinned Latin witness of q.103 exists.
